how_measured: Coarse 1/4-scale whole-sheet view located 'Scale of Feet' near the bottom-right of the mapped area. Crop (x0=2350,y0=3740) upscaled 4x read the labelling. Each tick then re-cropped at 16x and 30x with a 1-source-pixel red grid overlay drawn at known source x, so tick centres were read directly in source coordinates with no back-conversion needed. Example back-conversion for the 4x survey crop: a feature at u=715 in the PNG is at x = 2350 + 715/4 = 2528.8. Tick strokes are 1-2 px wide; darkest columns were 2530/2531 (0 ft), 2683/2684 (50), 2837 (100), 2989 (150).
notes: Bar runs from a subdivided -50 ft extension (labelled 50 40 30 20 10) through 0, 50, i00, 150. Tick spacing 152.9 / 153.8 / 151.8 px per 50 ft; left terminus predicted at 2377.8 and observed at ~2378.0, confirming linearity over the whole 200 ft bar.
